What does AI-first mean for my shipment?
The slow parts move faster: finding the right code, checking documents, calculating duty and spotting problems early. A licensed broker still makes every customs decision and signs every filing.
Will a computer file my bill of entry?
No. AI helps prepare and check the information, but every bill of entry and shipping bill is reviewed and filed by our licensed team under customs broker licence R-7/92.

Our free tools run in your browser, so the numbers and files you enter are not uploaded to us. Documents you send us for a shipment are handled only in systems we control and are never shared publicly.
Can I still speak to a person?
Always. Call +91 11 4160 3301, email info@yamlogistics.com, or message us on WhatsApp @CARGOKIT or Telegram @YAMLOGISTICS during office hours (Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 18:00 IST).
Do the free tools cost anything?
No. The tracker, duty calculator, HSN finder, label generator, load calculator and the other tools are free, with no sign-up. If you want us to handle the shipment, ask for a quote.
